description: This file defines the ModulesLib class, which provides methods for generating paginated module records, handling sorting and filtering, and constructing pagination URLs within the SuiteCRM project. It is a core library component that interacts with SugarCRM beans, HTTP request/response, and JSON API structures.

classes.name: ModulesLib
classes.description: A library class providing module record retrieval, filtering, sorting, and pagination URL generation within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: generatePaginatedModuleRecords
methods.description: Generates a paginated list of module records, converting SugarBeans to JSON API format with links.

methods.name: generatePaginatedLinksFromModuleRecords
methods.description: Creates pagination links (self, first, last, prev, next) based on current request parameters and record counts.

methods.name: getSorting
methods.description: Parses the 'sort' request parameter to generate an SQL order by string.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Retrieves a filtered, sorted, and paginated list of SugarBean records based on request parameters.

methods.name: generatePaginationUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL for pagination links, including pagination, filter, sort, and field query parameters.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current user based on OAuth user ID from the request.
